description: Searches the topics (interests) that already exist by substring, or returns the first page when query is omitted. Returns topic ids and labels only, never who holds them. Read-only.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

query.description: Optional substring to filter labels by.

name: list_interests
title: List Existing Topics
